title: This Is Your FBI
paragraphs: A dramatized crime series produced with FBI cooperation, presenting cases involving espionage, kidnapping, fraud, organized crime, and other federal investigations.
ABC fact-based federal crime drama made with documented FBI cooperation.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: ABC weekly run (April 6, 1945 to January 30, 1953) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Frederick Steiner (composer, conductor, and music director), Jerry Devine (producer, writer, and director), [[person|stacy-harris|Stacy Harris]] (performer), Larry Keating (announcer, host, and narrator), William Woodson (narrator, announcer, and performer), Jerry D. Lewis (writer and director), and Dean Carlton (narrator).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]] and [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].
The stories often return to Robbery and theft, Homicide, Rackets and organized crime, Kidnapping, Juvenile delinquency, and Fraud and confidence schemes.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Wartime counterespionage and federal crime concerns, FBI crime-prevention public education, and Federal law-enforcement media outreach.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], [[show|escape|Escape]], and [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]].
